What we make

Gates, railings and so much more.

Made to order in wrought iron, steel, stainless steel and glass. Whatever you need, just ask.

Gates & automatic gates

Driveway, garden, metal and wrought iron gates, from simple pedestrian gates to grand entrances. Add automation and access control for security and convenience.

  • Driveway
  • Garden
  • Automatic
  • Access control

Balcony railings & balustrades

Wrought iron, stainless steel and glass balustrades for balconies, Juliet balconies, terraces and roof gardens, designed to suit your property.

  • Glass
  • Stainless
  • Wrought iron
  • Juliet balconies

Staircases & railing design

Internal and external staircases and handrails. David can help design your railings so they look right and meet your needs.

  • Staircases
  • Handrails
  • Design service

Security gates & grilles

Strong, well-made security grilles and security gates for homes and businesses, built to keep things safe without looking harsh.

  • Security grilles
  • Security gates
  • Metal gates

Bollards & traffic barriers

Bollards and traffic barriers for driveways, car parks and commercial sites, made to your size and finished to last.

  • Bollards
  • Traffic barriers
  • Commercial

Blacksmith & forgemaster

Traditional wrought ironwork and fabrication. If you can describe it, David can make it, in wrought iron, steel, stainless steel or glass.

  • Wrought ironwork
  • Custom fabrication
  • Any material

Finishing, done in-house

Powder coatingA tough, even colour finish

GlassworkToughened glass panels, cut to fit

About David

38 years of getting it right.

David Gillard is a friendly tradesman who has spent 38 years working with metal. No job is too big or too small, and he'll make anything you want in wrought iron, steel, stainless steel or glass.

You deal directly with David from first call to final fitting. He's happy to travel anywhere for the right job.
